name: Rotterdam Central Station
description: Major transportation hub and architectural landmark in Rotterdam, serving as the main railway station.

name: Erasmus Bridge
description: Iconic cable-stayed bridge spanning the Nieuwe Maas river, nicknamed 'The Swan' for its distinctive asymmetric pylon.

name: Euromast
description: Observation tower standing at 185 meters tall, offering panoramic views of Rotterdam and the surrounding region.

name: Markthal Rotterdam
description: Architectural marvel combining a residential and office building with a large indoor food market featuring stunning artwork.

name: Rotterdam Zoo (Diergaarde Blijdorp)
description: One of the oldest zoos in the Netherlands, home to over 2000 animals and featuring the Oceanium aquarium.

name: Cube Houses (Kubuswoningen)
description: Innovative tilted cube-shaped houses designed by architect Piet Blom, now an iconic Rotterdam landmark.

name: Schiedam Windmill Museum
description: Historic windmills in Schiedam, including the tallest traditional windmills in the world.

name: Vlaardingen City Center
description: Historic city center of Vlaardingen, known for its maritime heritage and fishing industry history.

name: Capelle aan den IJssel
description: Residential municipality in the Rijnmond region, known for its shopping center Slag om Blaak.

name: Kralingse Plas
description: Large recreational lake in Rotterdam, popular for water sports, cycling, and jogging trails.

name: Hoek van Holland
description: Coastal town at the mouth of the Nieuwe Waterweg, serving as a ferry port to the UK and popular beach destination.

name: Rotterdam The Hague Airport
description: Regional airport serving Rotterdam and The Hague, offering both business and leisure flights.
